relationships.subject: anandamide
relationships.evidence_quote: AEA is a partial agonist of cannabinoid receptors; a full agonist of the TRPV1 receptor

relationships.subject: FAAH
relationships.evidence_quote: Anandamide is broken down by fatty acid amide hydrolase (FAAH) into arachidonic acid and ethanolamine.

key_findings: Review of Cannabis phytocannabinoids and terpenes acting on CB1, CB2, TRP, PPAR and other targets with entourage effects.
